name: When should I consider replacing my water softener instead of repairing it?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my water softener instead of repairing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your water softener when repair costs approach or exceed half the price of a new unit, or if the system is old (typically over 10-15 years) and frequently breaks down. Repeated repairs on an aging unit can become less cost-effective than investing in a new, more efficient model. Our technicians can provide an assessment to help you make this practical tradeoff between repair and replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacement if repair costs are over half the price of a new unit, or if an old unit (10-15+ years) frequently breaks down. This can be a more cost-effective long-term solution.
